verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is from the community. It shows that GitHub code search exists (Microsoft started requiring a login to search code), but an older hands-on report calls that search 'terribly bad', to the point that cloning and grepping a repo is more efficient. The pack has no first-party documentation of cross-repository search. Missing for 10: first-party docs for cross-repo code search, evidence of file and commit search, and recent independent corroboration of search quality.
